verdict.rationale: Xero's documentation says JAX lets users create, edit, and send invoices with plain-language commands and gives instant answers about cash flow and financial health. JAX also categorizes and reconciles transactions, though that is described as automation rather than command-driven. An official MCP server and AI Toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain) also let users drive contacts, chart of accounts, and invoicing through external LLM agents in natural language. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of JAX's natural-language control, documented natural-language coverage beyond invoicing and Q&A (e.g. bills, payroll, reports), and depth on command limits or accuracy.
